frame.name: Starlight Beam
frame.description: This weapon fires a low-intensity Arc beam with enhanced stability and accuracy.

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.description:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Phase Converter
perks.description: When aiming down sights, the beam is compressed into short, high-energy bursts that interact with targets affected by Arc debuffs, dealing increased damage and causing them to detonate into blinding explosions on final blows.

perks.name: Arc Alignment
perks.description: Dealing Arc damage from any source aligns the battery's coils. When alignment is complete, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to disengage the safety and enable hip-fired Starlight Beam to apply Jolt to any targets damaged for a short time.  Aim down sights to slow the rate at which the battery drains.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

catalyst.name: Lodestar Catalyst
catalyst.description: While amplified, this weapon gains greatly increased reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights.
